s64: Grow One Virtue at a Time

s68: Write when you most often fail in it

s70: Pray each morning for the Spirit's help in that virtue
s71: Review each night and start again tomorrow when you fail
s73: Failure is part of training; count the times you chose well
s75: The Spirit grows the fruit, and we cooperate by practising

s78: Repeated choices strengthen neural pathways until they become habits, and habits become character. The brain rewards consistency, not intensity.
s79: Pick one good thing to grow, like patience. Practise it a little every day, and ask God to help you.
